title: The Mapmaker's Vigil
description: A solitary figure in a wide-brimmed hat and dark robes sits on a rocky outcrop overlooking a winding blue river and distant mountains. He holds an open illustrated map while a glowing white dove flies near his head, surrounded by ancient stone ruins, white roses, and four hanging tattered banners depicting symbolic imagery beneath a large glowing compass rose.
prompt: A lone figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat and dark robes sits on a rocky ledge studying an open illustrated map. A glowing white dove flies beside him. Ancient stone ruins and white roses surround the scene. Four torn banners hang in the dark sky showing a winged figure, a bull-headed being, and other symbols. A large glowing blue compass rose floats above. Winding blue river and misty mountains in the background, dramatic fantasy atmosphere.
